Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableMod_too: Master switch. If off, the mod does nothing at all: no capture, no logging, no spawn menu.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableSpawnMe: Adds "SCLG Spawn Test" to the right-click ground menu for admins/moderators, with preset zombie templates to reproduce the loot-loss bug on demand.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableFileLog: Writes the losses, summary, cases, recovery-simulation and spawn logs to the server's Zomboid/Lua/ folder. Turn off to keep console-only output.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableRecover: Enabled by default. For every detected or suspected case, writes what a future recovery would restore or reject, its evidence source and confidence. DRY RUN only: it never creates, moves, removes or restores items.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableConsole: Master switch for LOSS/WARN/INFO console lines. File logging is controlled separately. DETAIL remains separately disabled by default.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_RelayServerLo: Enabled by default. Sends enabled server console lines to subscribed client consoles in bounded batches, preserving [SRV]/[CLI] origin markers. Disable it to keep diagnostics only on the server.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnablePostAni: Tracks the same corpse through bounded checkpoints after the death animation, requiring repeated evidence before confirming that an item disappeared.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_PostAnimation: Adds a checkpoint at this age to the built-in 1, 3 and 7 second checks. It is clamped by the total timeline duration.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_TimelineMaxSe: Keeps bounded checkpoints for the same corpse until this age. Longer timelines improve confirmation but retain corpse references and diagnostic state for longer.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_TimelineConfi: Number of consecutive timeline checkpoints in which the same itemId must remain absent before it is classified as a confirmed disappearance.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableNearbyP: When the post-death-animation recheck finds fewer items, checks if a player was close enough to have legitimately looted the corpse themselves. If so, logs it as informational instead of a loss, to avoid false positives from normal looting.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableMovemen: Only when an item disappears from a tracked corpse, searches its exact itemId in online-player inventories and nearby loaded containers/world items. Read-only and bounded; distinguishes movement from destruction.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_MovementSearc: Radius around the corpse inspected only for an already-missing itemId. Higher values improve movement detection but inspect more loaded world containers.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_ShowCaseNotif: Shows a short overhead message to the client observer (or nearest player) when a possible loss opens, becomes confirmed, or is proven to be a normal item movement. Useful for visually validating the corpse immediately.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableCapacit: Logs the corpse container's weight/capacity right after it's rebuilt, to test whether items could be silently dropped for exceeding a capacity limit rather than an instantiation failure.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableDeathCo: Enable death context capture (weapon, animation state)

Records the weapon used in the last hit and the zombie's crawling/fallen state at death, included in loss log lines, to help spot whether a specific weapon type or death animation correlates with the bug.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableAuthent: When a zombie was visually wearing Authentic Z clothing before dying, tries to instantiate those items the same way the game's corpse rebuild does, to test whether they fail to create (a real engine error seen with Authentic Z items). Confirms or rules out Authentic Z as the cause of the loot-loss bug with real data.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_Debug: SiK Corpse Loot Guard: diagnostics & logs
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableFallbac: Samples zombie state periodically as a backup capture path, for deaths that don't go through a weapon hit (fire, falls, etc). Has a performance cost with many zombies on screen; turn off if you only care about melee/firearm deaths.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_ZombieUpdateS: >>> Capture: fallback sample rate (1 in N)
OnZombieUpdate fires per zombie per tick. Only 1 in N calls is processed. Lower = more accurate fallback capture but higher performance cost.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_SummaryInterv: How often the accumulated-stats summary line is printed/written.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_VerboseDebug_: High-volume sublog for captures, cache sweeps, correlation and rechecks, including zombies without losses. A SYSTEM warning appears before DETAIL lines. Enable only for a targeted diagnosis.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_ClientVisualS: How often (seconds) each client scans nearby zombies for a fallback visual report, for deaths without a weapon hit (fire, vehicle...). Lower = more up to date, more network traffic.
Only zombies within this distance from the player are sampled by the periodic fallback scan.
Max number of new zombies reported per periodic scan - keeps network traffic bounded when many zombies are nearby at once.
